ops.text: walk 12 S2 close-out: one norbridgewoodplanks02 gives a 0.70 m deck, under the 0.80 m walkable width (0.6 m capsule + 0.2 m). Two lie side by side at 0.90 m centres on both legs, about 1.6 m wide. The kit row now carries a mesh collider (it had collision none: drawn, never collided). The outer leg climbs from the pier over the bulwark gap; the inner leg steps down to the deck, as on a ship's boarding plank. A KotM shipplank02 in one straight piece was tried and refused: its long axis is kit x, so the runtime cannot pitch it up the 1.7 m from pier to deck.

ops.text: walk 11 C2f: the climbing route is two roots meeting on the west bluff face. k-root (histroots05, yaw 45, pitch 30, pivot y 1.75) runs from the strand mud (lowest point 0.86 m in) up the face to 3.5 m; k-root2 (histroots05, yaw 165, pitch -10, pivot y 3.25) hangs from the bluff top (its top 7.68 m at (3919.08, 1351.15), 0.24 m into the ground) down the face to 3.06 m; the two ends stand 0.53 m apart. Pose pair from work/c2f/root_pair_sweep.py (face distance per vertex, as C2d): every vertex of both within 0.5 m of the face, none over the water, no vertex of either top 2 m out from the face and off the ground. ops.text: 16x part 5: the way down reaches this landing by two cut earth legs and no stair. The upper cut (wd-cut) falls west at 27 degrees to the bench in the corner of the west bluff (wd-turn). The lower cut (wd-cut2) falls east at 29 degrees along the foot of the cliff to the dry shelf at the head of this landing. A 47-degree stair on an open face read as a ladder. The cliff way names only this landing. Its pathZM is the shelf, because the legs are ground. cliffWay.connected walks them from the camp to the water.

aground, static by design: the hull draws 4.61 m (water-motion-classes assetDraughtM) in 1.2 m of water (keel in the silt, as the walk 11 berth was chosen). Afloat, the buoyant floor clamp would lift it 3.4 m out of the water away from its 20 deck pieces. Placed --wet --beached, it keeps its float-line seat and never moves. Its gangways rest on it.
16x craft: the gang's rowboat floats on an anchor line to the bed (tether seabed, depth plus the measured wave crest): untethered it drifted off the landing.
